about_the_game:
Ever War is a turn-based strategy game where you manage settlements and armies to lead your kingdom to victory over your opponents. Raise great armies to destroy all who oppose you, secure access to valuable resources and conquer the realm.

Build Your Empire

Manage the expansion of your empire, supervising all aspects of each of your settlements including population growth, constructing buildings, army training and trade between settlements. All entirely based on your own preferences and playstyle.

Command armies

March into battle with a complex system that allows you to command armies up to hundreds of troops. Use the unique abilities of your units to create unbeatable formations, set up devastating ambushes, and take advantage of favorable terrain along with other strategies to ensure victory for your faction.

Three factions 

Lead one of three unique factions in the conflict for control over this realm. Medlend, the kingdom of knights and Princes, the true rulers of this realm despite their constant strife from invaders and secessionists. Kursians, a race of highly numerous rodents from the great forests of the far east whose goal is endless expansion. Boraeloth, tribes of half giant raiders of the cold north whose lone wish is to pillage the cities of the civilized world.

Key Features

-Turn-based empire management fused with tactical turn-based battles.

-Turn-based battles fought on 3d hex grids where terrain and positioning is critical.

-3 factions with unique unit rosters, each of which consists of over 15 units.

-Various unit types including melee infantry, Missile infantry, shock cavalry, missile cavalry, war monsters and more. 

-3 different campaigns with distinct start locations and challenges that occur.

-Large tile based campaign map consisting of mountain ranges, rivers and over 20 settlements to conquer and absorb into your empire.

-Nearly 30 different buildings to construct and upgrade in whatever combinations fit your campaign plan.

-Challenging AI opponents that invade your empire and take advantage of your weaknesses.

-Over 20 distinct resources to manage and secure for your empire.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.8 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Ever War is a turn-based strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. This game combines empire-building, resource management and large-scale tactical turn-based battles.
